description: This PHP class defines a controller for managing a blog module within the OpenCart e-commerce platform's admin panel. It handles rendering the module's configuration page, saving module settings, adding new modules, and deleting existing modules, with proper permission checks and dynamic data handling.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for the blog module in the OpenCart admin extension. Manages configuration, creation, editing, and deletion of blog modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main configuration page for the blog module, assembling breadcrumb navigation, fetching module info, and loading views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the blog module's settings, including validation and permission checks, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new blog module entry, with permission validation, and returns a success or error message as JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified blog module by ID, after permission validation, with JSON response indicating success or failure.
